project_name: AO-360 — AO Achievement Dashboard (PT BPRS Haji Miskin)
target_audience: Bank Executives (Director Hendri Kamal), System Administrators, AO Lending Officers, AO Funding Officers, and PIC Remedial Officers at PT BPRS Haji Miskin.
archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Sharia Banking Authority & Precision)
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a modern, clean, high-density internal banking performance management app for PT BPRS Haji Miskin.
Ensure complete coverage of all 5 role views: Executive Dashboard (Director Hendri Kamal), Admin Dashboard, AO Lending Dashboard, AO Funding Dashboard, and Remedial Dashboard.
Implement the custom BPRS Haji Miskin logo badge with Islamic geometry/calligraphy styling in Emerald Green and Gold on login and navigation header.
All numerical amounts must be properly formatted in Indonesian Rupiah (e.g., Rp 1.250.000.000 or Rp 1,25 M).
Use strict cardless / subtle rounded borders (max rounded-lg) with clear slate divides instead of heavy drop shadows or excessive animations.
Include a functional role switcher in the header/login for easy evaluation of all dashboards.
Collection activity flow MUST feature photo upload simulation with real-time GPS location watermark preview, timestamp, and map coordinate link.
All interactive and metric elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='kpi-card-total-disbursement').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders (border-slate-200 / border-slate-700).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers and floating contextual filter bars.
MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add specific transitions for hover/focus (e.g., transition-colors duration-150).
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep strict left-aligned reading rhythm.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for system icons. Use Lucide React icons (@lucide/react or lucide-react).
Every interaction needs clean feedback - subtle hover highlights, state badges, and instant table filtering.
All key interactive elements and data cards MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

grids_and_layouts.kpi_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
grids_and_layouts.card_style: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow transition-shadow p-5

components_and_features.name: Header & Executive Topbar
components_and_features.description: Displays PT BPRS Haji Miskin logo, active role selector (Executive, Admin, AO Lending, AO Funding, Remedial), Period Filter (MTD/YTD, Month/Year), and user profile badge for Director Hendri Kamal.

components_and_features.name: Executive Dashboard View
components_and_features.description: Executive summary for Director Hendri Kamal: Total Financing Portfolio, NPF Net (1.82%), NPF Bruto (2.45%), Total DPK, Overall KPI Target vs Actual gauge, and Top AO Rankings.

components_and_features.name: AO Lending Dashboard
components_and_features.description: Pencapaian Pencairan (Disbursement), Target vs Actual bar chart, Portfolio Kolektibilitas 1-5 pie chart, Performance Score gauge (Weighted target metrics), and Nasabah list.

components_and_features.name: AO Funding Dashboard
components_and_features.description: Tabungan & Deposito Sharia growth, Deposit NOA, Target vs Realisasi DPK, and Top Depositor accounts.

components_and_features.name: Remedial & Collection Dashboard
components_and_features.description: Recovery Write-Off (WO), Restrukturisasi Pembiayaan, Kolek 3-5 action queue, and Collection Activity Log.

components_and_features.name: Collection Activity Documentation Modal
components_and_features.description: Field Officer photo capture / upload simulation with auto-generated GPS watermark (Latitude, Longitude, Address, Timestamp), result note, and status update.

components_and_features.name: Admin Management Console
components_and_features.description: User Account Management, Target & Weight Setting (Bobot KPI), Excel Data Import/Export preview, System Backup & Restore simulation, Audit Logs.

components_and_features.name: Portfolio Data Table with Filters
components_and_features.description: High density table showing Account Number, Customer Name, Akad (Murabahah, Musyarakah, Mudharabah), Plafon, Baki Debet, Kolektibilitas status badge, AO Name, and action buttons.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large numeric KPIs.
accessibility.focus_states: ring-2 ring-emerald-600 ring-offset-2 outline-none for interactive controls.
accessibility.testing_attributes: Add data-testid to every filter dropdown, table row, tab button, search input, and export button.
